summary: Iteration_23 (RESTORE FIFO supplier debt + extend for paper-only suppliers) fully verified. Backend: 11/11 new paper-only supplier FIFO tests + 15/15 restored FIFO debt payment tests + 45/45 paper_orders & returns_flow regression tests = 71/71 PASS. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): after login as 07700000001/pass123 and navigating to /accounting/supplier-accounts, the list correctly shows 6 suppliers including 5 local:* paper-only suppliers alongside the marketplace supplier 'مذخر النور'. Tapping into a local:* row (sa-local:a5a324264498, 'مذخر بدون حساب') renders the full 'تسديد دين' UI with subtitle 'مذخر من طلبية مصورة', 4 balance cards, FIFO hint, expandable unpaid invoices list (8 invoices shown), amount input, 'سداد كامل' shortcut, notes field, pay button, payment history section, and 'الطلبيات المصورة (8)' section with paid/partial badges — identical to the marketplace supplier flow. All key testIDs (btn-toggle-invoices, pay-amount, btn-full-amount, pay-notes, btn-pay-supplier, sa-{supplier_id}) are present and functional. Backfill of legacy paper orders (5 pre-existing without supplier_id) into local:* IDs confirmed via GET /supplier-accounts. The 7 failures in test_revert_and_paper_orders_tab.py are EXPECTED (those tests were written to prove the FIFO endpoints were removed in iter22; now that iter23 RESTORED them at user's explicit request, those inverted-assertion tests must fail — this is not a regression).
action_items: Optional: delete or rewrite /app/backend/tests/test_revert_and_paper_orders_tab.py — it was iteration_22 revert-verification and now correctly fails because iter23 restored the endpoints it asserted were removed. Its assertions on 'no invoices_paid_total', 'no /pay endpoint', 'orders have no enrichment' are all now false-by-design. Keep only if the intent shifts; otherwise remove to avoid CI noise.
critical_code_review_comments: accounting.py L152-181: _pharmacy_supplier_debit + _paper_orders_debit both return {debit, paid} dicts — clean parallelism. Aggregation is safe with $ifNull fallbacks for legacy docs missing 'total' or 'paid_amount'.

accounting.py L184-216: _read_supplier_account correctly composes marketplace + paper debits, subtracts invoices_paid_total AND credit_applied — max(0, …) prevents negatives. Auto-inserts stub supplier_accounts doc so subsequent updates never race.

accounting.py L707-806: /accounting/supplier-accounts lazy backfill runs O(N) once per list call — safe because updates are idempotent (both paper_orders.$set supplier_id and supplier_ledger insert are guarded by 'not existing'). Backfilled ledger notes tagged '(backfill)'.

accounting.py L920-1043: /pay endpoint properly sorts invoices by created_at ASC (line 953), rejects overpay with Arabic error (line 956-957), branches marketplace vs paper writes, records master ledger entry with allocations[] array + fully_paid counts + recorded_by. Payment_master_id used consistently for cross-referencing sub-payments on paper orders.

paper_orders.py L358-368: local:* id generation is deterministic (md5(pharmacy_id|supplier_name.lower())[:12]) — same supplier_name from same pharmacy always maps to the same local sid, guaranteeing multi-invoice grouping. Good.
paper_orders.py L397-409: supplier_ledger paper_order_debit entry now inserted regardless of local vs real supplier — fixes the pre-iter23 gap where local orders were invisible in the ledger UI.
[supplierId].tsx: handles both is_local (subtitle 'مذخر من طلبية مصورة') and marketplace suppliers with the same JSX branch. All key testIDs present.
Backend response shapes have no MongoDB _id leaks — verified in regression test test_supplier_accounts_list_shape.

success_rate.backend: 100% (71/71 relevant tests: 11 new paper-only + 15 restored FIFO + 45 regression). test_revert_and_paper_orders_tab.py 7/14 fails are EXPECTED — those specifically verified endpoints that are now intentionally restored.
success_rate.frontend: 100% (login + navigation + supplier list with paper-only suppliers visible + detail with full FIFO UI + is_local subtitle + expandable invoices verified on 390x844)
